description: Customer master: one row per registered customer with city, country, segment and signup date.
Order header: one row per customer order with status, sales channel and total order value.
Order line items: product, quantity, unit price and discount for every order line.
Product catalogue with category, list price, launch date and active flag.
Marketing campaigns with channel, flight dates, budget and actual spend.
Website sessions with landing page, attributed campaign, pageviews and conversion flag.
Invoices issued for orders, with tax amount, due date and payment status (open, paid, overdue).
Payments received against invoices, by payment method and date.
Certified monthly gross revenue, net revenue and refunds by region. Official source for revenue reporting.
Employee directory with department, job title, manager, hire date and salary.
Payroll results per employee and pay period: gross pay and net pay.
Customer support tickets with channel, category, priority, status and resolution time.
Customer satisfaction (CSAT) survey responses linked to support tickets, scored 1 to 5.
Monthly customer churn: active customers, churned customers and churn rate by segment and region.
Daily sales KPIs by channel: number of orders, revenue and average order value.
